title: 3 1.3.2 The highest percentage of increase in 1986 over 1985 was noticed under 'Counterfeiting' (12.2) followed by 'Rape' (9.1), 'Cheating' (7.4), 'Murder' (5.0), 'Culpable homicide not amounting to murder' (5.0), 'Other IPC Offences' (4.6) and 'Criminal Breach of Trust' (3.3), Whereas a decline was recorded under 'Dacoity' (7.2), 'Riots' (5.6), Kidnapping and Abduction' (2.4), 'Theft' (2.1), 'Burglary' (1.1) and 'Robbery' (0.5). As compared to quinquennial average of 1981-1985 the incidence of crime in 1986 registered an increase under 'Counterfeiting' (56.9), 'Rape' (28.7), 'Cheating' (18.7), 'Other IPC Offences' (14.7), 'Culpable homicide not amounting to murder' (12.9), 'Murder' (10.9), 'Kidnapping and Abduction' (8.5) and 'Criminal Breach of Trust' (1.0). Robbery did not show any change in percentage during 1986 although the numerical increase was of 5 cases over the Quinquennial Average of 1981-1985. The crime heads to register a decline were 'Dacoity' (17.5), 'Theft' (10.7), 'Riot' (10.5) and 'Burglary' (8.7). The Pattern of I.P.C. Crime :
